checks.scope: Both saved independent controls fail on the broken source and pass on the candidate. Additional event-order and lifecycle checks pass.
All 12 cases fail the original-deadline invariant. Compilation passes. No sanitizer error precedes the assertion.

findings.title: Disconnect submission can occur after the original deadline.
findings.cause: blec_poll checks the deadline. The direct stop and successful connection-event paths call blec_disconnect without that check.
findings.service_timing: ble_central_service calls blec_stop before HCI reads and blec_poll. At the next tick, c.now_ms can still contain the previous tick.
findings.observed_api: At now_ms=deadline=3100, stop submits one accepted Disconnect after an earlier refusal.
findings.observed_service_order: The previous poll is at 3099. The next tick is 3100. Stop submits one accepted Disconnect before poll detects expiry.
findings.observed_cancel_race: A successful connection event at or after the original stop deadline submits Disconnect before the next poll detects expiry.
coverage: Stop after an HCI event updates now_ms.
Stop with the production stop-before-poll order.
Exact deadline and deadline plus 1 ms.
Normal time and uint32_t timer wrap.
findings.impact: The promised original cutoff does not apply to all command-submission paths.
findings.guard_limit: A deadline check that uses stale c.now_ms alone does not repair the production stop-before-poll path.
findings.disposition: Use one fresh stage2 for the source repair. Then use one fresh stage3. Do not advance this candidate to stage4.
repair_requirements: Use the actual current tick before any possible submission.
Apply the original cutoff to every Disconnect submission path.
Do not renew an active abort deadline.
Retain acceptance state and stop intent.
Retain the connection and credits until the applicable successful Disconnection Complete event.
Preserve a bounded failure when the transport stays busy or completion is absent.
findings.limits: The service-order probe reproduces the relevant public API call order. It does not execute the complete TIMER5 service or target interrupts.

passing_review: Transport acceptance sets D_SENT only after send returns success.
Successful command events do not clear the connection or restore credits.
Failed command events keep the connection and credits in FAILED.
Repeated stop after FAILED does not renew the deadline.
Late successful disconnect respects stop intent.
A completion before command status cannot acknowledge the new scan command.
The full signaling queue, fragment bounds and reconnect-credit repairs remain present.
The new fields remain in the TIMER5 context. The main loop produces the existing feedback queue.
physical_limit: The host checks do not establish a physical PASS or a complete cure.
